subject: Re-implement page reference bit emulation by using the (otherwise unused) valid bit. This is faster than the "unmap all" solution that were described in that Mach paper _and_ it eliminates the need for checking the wired bit. As a result of this; swapping started working again on vax :-)

More cleanup... * Don't bother pulling PT_M and PT_H bits from pv_flags; they can't ever be   set there! * Actually make pmap_clear_reference() do something useful. * Also set the referenced bit (PT_H) when emulating a write fault.
